record.question: Which validated rulers license an implementation in Sounding Line Stage 5?
record.what_happened: Licensed: competence_history_signatures, counterfactual_source_probes, equivalence_class_reporting; partial: joint_reader_posterior, route_reliability_weights; deferred: learning_progress_selector; killed: none.
record.what_changed_in_the_project_world: What Sounding Line may implement is exactly what landed, and no more.

hypothesis: Only rulers every one of whose licensing cards landed with its criterion held are licensed for Sounding Line Stage 5; a failed instrument licenses nothing.

joint_reader_posterior.access: action, semantic and context observations per episode; a held-out next action
joint_reader_posterior.gate: a constructed corpus in which the joint estimator beats independent marginals on a hidden next action at matched evidence
joint_reader_posterior.shape: joint > staged > independent, with class-level uncertainty under equifinality

route_reliability_weights.access: per-route feedback on training items without target labels at test
route_reliability_weights.gate: a planted corpus where one route is degraded and learned weights beat equal weights; ease crossed against accuracy
route_reliability_weights.shape: learned weights track accuracy, not ease; duplicates fused by cause

competence_history_signatures.access: execution-accuracy and early-token records of a maker across episodes
competence_history_signatures.gate: planted competence and planted history recovered independently on a constructed corpus
competence_history_signatures.shape: two dissociable signatures with different correction dynamics

counterfactual_source_probes.access: a correction event and an off-audience action per source, beside the artifact
counterfactual_source_probes.gate: a constructed corpus where fanatic and propagandist collide on the artifact and separate on probes
counterfactual_source_probes.endpoint: pairwise accuracy with and without probes; abstention mass
counterfactual_source_probes.shape: chance from the artifact, separation from probes, factored uptake

learning_progress_selector.access: the learner's own recent surprise per item and a cost per look
learning_progress_selector.gate: the unlearnable-noise trap on a constructed item set
learning_progress_selector.shape: progress avoids noise, gain per cost beats fixed policies, abstention on null probes

equivalence_class_reporting.access: a declared hypothesis grid with its equivalences
equivalence_class_reporting.gate: planted equifinal and reward-equivalent pairs keep their class mass
equivalence_class_reporting.shape: spread within the class, contraction on resolving evidence

gates.name: every_candidate_has_a_recommendation
gates.detail: an analytic identity the harness has to satisfy

gates.name: placebo:no_failed_instrument_licenses
gates.detail: an irrelevant matched intervention does not change the target

gates.name: positive:recommendations_mechanical
gates.detail: a known readable manipulation is recovered

gates_summary.how_to_read: a gate RECORDS here and does not raise, so an exploratory sweep is never killed mid-run. tests/test_gates.py walks every committed verdict and fails the suite on anything in failed_names or unexpected_passes, which puts the hard stop where a result would become public. THREE categories, and they are not the same thing: failed_names is a control that broke; documented_failures is a gate marked expected_to_fail, which records a KNOWN defect so the evidence travels with the result (S-2's dead manipulation, S-3's fitted threshold); unexpected_passes is a documented defect that has started passing, which means somebody fixed it without updating the gate and is the one nobody would otherwise notice. A skipped gate counts as passing but is reported separately: it means an optional dependency was absent, never that a check succeeded.
